title: Present Continuous Tense — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: "She are reading a book." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: She memakai is: She is reading.

items.prompt: "I is drawing a cat." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: I memakai am: I am drawing.

items.prompt: "They are swiming now." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Ejaan yang tepat: swimming (m dobel).

items.prompt: Which sentence tells us something is happening now?

visual.text: Look! The cat is climbing the tree.

choices.say: Look! The cat is climbing the tree.

visual.text: The cat climbs trees every day.

choices.say: The cat climbs trees every day.

visual.text: The cat climbed the tree yesterday.

choices.say: The cat climbed the tree yesterday.

visual.text: The cat will climb the tree.

choices.say: The cat will climb the tree.

items.reteach: Look! + is climbing = sedang terjadi sekarang.

items.prompt: "The boys is playing marbles." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: The boys (banyak) memakai are.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Mom in the kitchen is correct?
items.reteach: Mom + is + cooking.

items.prompt: "He is write a story now." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah is pakai -ing: He is writing.

items.prompt: Which question about the children and the TV is correct?
items.reteach: They memakai are: Are they watching TV?

items.prompt: "Look! The baby is cry." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah is pakai -ing: crying.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the weather now is correct?
items.reteach: It + is + raining.

items.prompt: "We am waiting for the bus." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: We memakai are: We are waiting.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Grandpa is correct?

visual.text: Grandpa is not sleeping. He is reading.

choices.say: Grandpa is not sleeping. He is reading.

visual.text: Grandpa is not sleep. He is read.

choices.say: Grandpa is not sleep. He is read.

visual.text: Grandpa are not sleeping. He are reading.

choices.say: Grandpa are not sleeping. He are reading.

items.reteach: Grandpa = he: is not sleeping, is reading.

items.prompt: What is Ana doing at the park?

stimulus.text: It is Sunday morning at the park. Ana is riding a bike. Two boys are flying kites. A man is selling ice cream.

items.reteach: Ana is riding a bike.

items.prompt: How many boys are flying kites at the park?

stimulus.text: It is Sunday morning at the park. Ana is riding a bike. Two boys are flying kites. A man is selling ice cream.

items.reteach: Two boys are flying kites.

items.prompt: What is the man at the park selling?

stimulus.text: It is Sunday morning at the park. Ana is riding a bike. Two boys are flying kites. A man is selling ice cream.

items.reteach: A man is selling ice cream.

items.prompt: Where is Mom?

stimulus.text: Mom is in the kitchen. She is cooking soup. Dad is helping her. He is cutting the carrots.

items.reteach: Mom is in the kitchen.

items.prompt: What is Dad cutting?

stimulus.text: Mom is in the kitchen. She is cooking soup. Dad is helping her. He is cutting the carrots.

items.reteach: He is cutting the carrots.

items.prompt: In the kitchen text, "her" means …

stimulus.text: Mom is in the kitchen. She is cooking soup. Dad is helping her. He is cutting the carrots.

items.reteach: Dad is helping her: Ayah membantu Ibu.

items.prompt: Where is Rafi now?

stimulus.text: Rafi is at Kenjeran Beach in Surabaya. The sun is shining. He is building a sandcastle. His sister is looking for shells.

items.reteach: Rafi is at Kenjeran Beach. Beach = pantai.

items.prompt: What is Rafi's sister doing?

stimulus.text: Rafi is at Kenjeran Beach in Surabaya. The sun is shining. He is building a sandcastle. His sister is looking for shells.

items.reteach: His sister is looking for shells.

items.prompt: How is the weather at Kenjeran Beach?

stimulus.text: Rafi is at Kenjeran Beach in Surabaya. The sun is shining. He is building a sandcastle. His sister is looking for shells.

items.reteach: The sun is shining, jadi cuacanya cerah: sunny.

items.prompt: What is Bagus doing at the moment?

headers: What is he or she doing?
stimulus.caption: Class 2 at the moment

items.reteach: Baris Bagus: playing chess.

items.prompt: Who is singing a song at the moment?

headers: What is he or she doing?
stimulus.caption: Class 2 at the moment

items.reteach: Baris Ira: singing a song.

items.prompt: Who is using a brush and colours?

headers: What is he or she doing?
stimulus.caption: Class 2 at the moment

items.reteach: Melukis memakai kuas dan warna. Tika is painting a picture.

items.prompt: Ani: "Where is Dad?" Budi: "He is in the kitchen. He is ___ dinner."
items.reteach: Sesudah is pakai -ing: cooking.

items.prompt: Grandma (on the phone): "What are you doing, Rina?" Rina: "I ___ my homework, Grandma."
items.reteach: I am doing.

items.prompt: Mom: "Is it raining outside?" Dino: "Yes, it ___. Take an umbrella."
items.reteach: Is it …? dijawab Yes, it is.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Are you listening, children?" Children: "Yes, we ___."
items.reteach: Are you …? dijawab Yes, we are.

items.prompt: Sari: "Is your brother sleeping?" Toni: "No, he ___. He is playing."
items.reteach: Is he …? dijawab No, he isn't.

items.prompt: Kiki: "Why are you wearing a jacket?" Lulu: "Because it ___ cold."
items.reteach: It + is + getting: semakin dingin.

items.prompt: Dad: "What is the cat doing?" Mia: "It ___ with a ball."
items.reteach: It is playing.

items.prompt: Ira: "Shh! The baby ___." Joni: "OK, I will be quiet."
items.reteach: The baby is sleeping.

items.prompt: Coach: "Who is running so fast?" Nia: "Dodi ___!"
items.reteach: Jawaban singkat: Dodi is (running).

items.prompt: On the phone: "Hello, Rudi. Where are you?" Rudi: "I am at the market. I ___ some fruit."
items.reteach: I am buying.

items.prompt: Mom: "Are you and Toni watching TV?" Tina: "No, we ___. We are reading."
items.reteach: Are you and Toni …? dijawab No, we aren't.

items.prompt: At a bus stop in Malang: "What are you waiting for?" Eka: "We ___ for the bus."
items.reteach: We are waiting.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "Ani is singing."
items.reteach: Tambahkan not sesudah is: Ani is not singing.

items.prompt: Change into a question: "They are playing."
items.reteach: Pindahkan are ke depan: Are they playing?

items.prompt: Change "I" to "She": "I am drawing."
items.reteach: She is drawing.

items.prompt: Change to now: "Tom swims every day." Look! Tom ___ now.
items.reteach: Sekarang: is + swimming.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: is / the / cat / sleeping / sofa / on / the

visual.text: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

choices.say: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

visual.text: The cat sleeping is on the sofa.

choices.say: The cat sleeping is on the sofa.

visual.text: The cat is on sleeping the sofa.

choices.say: The cat is on sleeping the sofa.

visual.text: Sleeping the cat is on the sofa.

choices.say: Sleeping the cat is on the sofa.

items.reteach: Pola: The cat + is sleeping + on the sofa.

items.prompt: Change "He" to "We": "He is eating."
items.reteach: We are eating.

items.prompt: Change into a question: "Dad is washing the car."
items.reteach: Pindahkan is ke depan: Is Dad washing the car?

items.prompt: Arrange the words: are / We / a / reading / book
items.reteach: Pola: We + are reading + a book.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "The birds are singing."
items.reteach: Are + not + singing.

items.prompt: Change to now: "Mom cooks every evening." Look! Mom ___ now.
items.reteach: Sekarang: is + cooking.

items.prompt: Change "You" to "Rina": "You are dancing."
items.reteach: Rina = she: Rina is dancing.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: playing / the / in / are / garden / children / The

visual.text: The children are playing in the garden.

choices.say: The children are playing in the garden.

visual.text: The children playing are in the garden.

choices.say: The children playing are in the garden.

visual.text: The children are in playing the garden.

choices.say: The children are in playing the garden.

visual.text: Playing the children are in the garden.

choices.say: Playing the children are in the garden.

items.reteach: Pola: The children + are playing + in the garden.

items.prompt: It is 7 p.m. Dodi is at the table with his family. They have rice and soup. Which sentence fits?
items.reteach: Jam 7 malam makan bersama keluarga: having dinner.

items.prompt: Odd one out: running, sitting, swimming, eating
items.reteach: Running, sitting, swimming punya huruf dobel. Eating tidak.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am holding an umbrella, and my clothes are wet. What is happening?
items.reteach: Payung dan baju basah: It is raining.

items.prompt: Fill both blanks: "I ___ reading, and my sisters ___ painting."
items.reteach: I am. My sisters (they) are.

items.prompt: Odd one out: is singing, are dancing, am reading, plays
items.reteach: Is singing, are dancing, am reading = sedang terjadi. Plays = kebiasaan.

items.prompt: Riddle: Ana is in the pool. Her hair is wet. She is moving her arms and legs. What is she doing?
items.reteach: Di kolam, menggerakkan tangan dan kaki: swimming.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses "now" correctly?
items.reteach: Now dipakai dengan is/am/are + -ing.

items.prompt: Fill both blanks: "___ you drawing?" "No, I ___ writing."
items.reteach: Are you …? No, I am writing.

items.prompt: Pattern: run → running, sit → sitting, swim → …
items.reteach: Polanya huruf terakhir digandakan: swimming.

items.prompt: Pattern: make → making, dance → dancing, smile → …
items.reteach: Polanya buang e lalu -ing: smiling.

items.prompt: Riddle: Everybody in the room is quiet. They are looking at books. Where are they?
items.reteach: Tenang dan membaca buku: di perpustakaan, library.

items.prompt: "Dad and I are fishing. Mom is reading. My two brothers are sleeping." How many people are sleeping?
items.reteach: My two brothers are sleeping: 2.
